beats.text: Full fine-tuning forces you to save a massive 175 billion parameter checkpoint for every single downstream task.
beats.visual_focus: A mountain of monolithic model files growing rapidly on a server disk.

beats.text: This creates a rigid storage wall; like duct-taping a full engine to a bicycle, it ignores the rank-deficiency of updates.
beats.visual_focus: A massive heavy brick dragging down a lightweight training pipeline.

beats.text: LoRA freezes those primary weights, instead projecting updates through tiny trainable matrices that capture the core task information.
beats.visual_focus: The frozen weight matrix remains still while two narrow slices rotate and update.
